answer: A Wesolowski VDF makes each extra identity pay 10 minutes of sequential squaring; a farm running N fakes pays N×10 minutes and cannot share it because each squaring depends on the one before, so extra cores buy nothing. To join, an agent computes x^(2^T) mod N with T=2^22, crossing a dune of squarings no falcon of parallel cores can shortcut, while the zephyr of cheap copies dies at verification. A 1,000-wallet farm dies by VDF check at 10,000 minutes of single-thread time, and wallets that skip the delay are pruned at the next epoch.
